== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes do not use Shelter in response to other party members taking damage or entering combat. Rather, they use Shelter when the hero itself has entered combat or aggroed an enemy.

==Notes==
* This [[skill]] creates a [[Spirit of Shelter]] at the user's location and removes any previous allied Spirit of Shelter.
* Often used with [[Displacement]] and [[Union]] to provide superior [[damage reduction]].
** Shelter and Union's effects are applied in the order they're created. For maximum damage reduction, always cast Shelter ''before'' Union.
* If [[Protective Spirit]] is applied on a target ''before'' Shelter is cast, the spirit does not lose health when the target would have taken high damage.
{{anomaly|[[Armor of Unfeeling]] will reduce the health loss of this spirit caused by its damage mitigation effect.}}
{{anomaly|While skill descriptions state "attacks", [[damage]] from [[spell]]s and [[signet]]s is also reduced.}}
{{anomaly|Shelter's effect persists briefly after it prevents damage in a way that would have killed it ([https://youtu.be/7AFx0dp8_-o video]).}}

==Trivia==
*The long version of this skill states that the spirit "''lasts .... seconds''" while most [[binding ritual]]s read "''dies after ....seconds''."
*The [[Player versus Environment|PvE]] and [[Player versus Player|PvP]] versions of this skill have different names in French:
**''"Refuge"'' (which translates to "shelter") in PvE
**''"Protection"'' (which translates to "protection") in PvP
